Interface skin

Text anti-aliasing

Grayscale smooths edges with gray pixels; Subpixel (LCD) uses red, green and blue subpixels for sharper text. Enhanced kerning enables proper letter spacing and ligatures. Image export supersampling renders PNG/JPEG at 2× or 4× resolution, then downsamples for smoother edges. The same settings are used for PNG and JPEG exports.

Shadow & glow

Select text first, then turn an effect on. With a caret, the next typed text receives it.

Outline & highlight

Select text, or place the caret to style text you type next.

Character position
